text.tspan: 虚拟时钟测试的四层技术栈：从接口注入到 OS 内核

text.font-family: "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Sans MS", "Bradley Hand", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
text.tspan: L1 应用层接口注入（Dependency Injection / Fake Clock）
代表：Go clockwork · Java java.time.Clock · Vitest/Sinon FakeTimers
特点：上手最稳，但侵入业务签名，容易漏掉第三方库内部直接调 time.Now()

text.font-family: "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Sans MS", "Bradley Hand", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
text.tspan: L2 运行时 / 异步执行器级虚拟时钟（Runtime Virtual Clock）
代表：Go 1.25 testing/synctest · Rust tokio::time::pause() · Python time-machine
特点：几乎零改业务代码；靠隔离域或单线程静止判定实现毫秒级自动快进

text.font-family: "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Sans MS", "Bradley Hand", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
text.tspan: L3 确定性模拟引擎（DST 离散事件队列 DES）
代表：FoundationDB Flow · TigerBeetle · Rust Turmoil
特点：时钟 + 网络 + 磁盘全入最小堆；支持多节点独立 Clock Skew / Drift 与 8 字节种子复现

text.font-family: "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Sans MS", "Bradley Hand", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
text.tspan: L4 操作系统 / 动态链接拦截层（OS / LD_PRELOAD / Time Namespace）
代表：libfaketime（LD_PRELOAD）· Chaos Mesh vDSO 注入 · Linux Time Namespace
特点：黑盒零改代码，但静态 Go 二进制直调 vDSO 会穿透 LD_PRELOAD，隔离粒度粗

text.font-family: "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Sans MS", "Bradley Hand", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
text.tspan: 越往下越透明（业务侵入更小）

text.font-family: "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Sans MS", "Bradley Hand", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
text.tspan: 从单机统一时间 -> 多节点时钟漂移

text.font-family: "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Sans MS", "Bradley Hand", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
